stages.title: MAHZAR: SCOPE BEFORE SIGNIFICANCE

pills.text: AKBAR BECAME POPE, PROPHET OR AN INFALLIBLE LAWGIVER
AFTER JURISTS DISAGREE, HE SELECTS AN EXISTING OPINION FOR
CLERICAL MONOPOLY NARROWS AS IMPERIAL ARBITRATION GROWS
BOUNDED JURISTIC CHOICE IS NOT UNLIMITED SACRED LEGISLATION.

SIGNIFICANCE → clerical monopoly narrows as imperial arbitration grows
LIMIT → bounded juristic choice is not unlimited sacred legislation.

stages.title: SULH-I-KUL AS A GOVERNING PRINCIPLE

pills.text: A PLURAL, RANKED EMPIRE NEEDS ORDER BEYOND THEOLOGICAL AGREEMENT
JUSTICE, TAX REFORM, WIDER SERVICE AND CALIBRATED PATRONAGE
THE EMPEROR STILL DEFINES INCLUSION, PROTECTION AND COERCION
DURABLE IMPERIAL IDIOM, NOT MODERN CONSTITUTIONAL SECULARISM.

sequence: PROBLEM → a plural, ranked empire needs order beyond theological agreement
MECHANISM → justice, tax reform, wider service and calibrated patronage
LIMIT → the emperor still defines inclusion, protection and coercion
VERDICT: durable imperial idiom, not modern constitutional secularism.
